WITH product_stats AS (
  SELECT
    p.product_id,
    p.production_type_code,
    AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS avg_product_quantity,
    COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS order_item_count,
    CAST(COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS DECIMAL(19,10)) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Order_Items), 0) AS order_item_share
  FROM Products p
  LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY p.product_id, p.production_type_code
),
type_averages AS (
  SELECT
    pc.product_type_description,
    AVG(ps.avg_product_quantity) AS avg_product_quantity,
    AVG(ps.order_item_count) AS avg_order_item_count,
    AVG(ps.order_item_share) AS avg_order_item_share
  FROM product_stats ps
  JOIN Product_Categories pc ON pc.production_type_code = ps.production_type_code
  GROUP BY pc.product_type_description
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_product_quantity) AS avg_product_quantity,
  AVG(avg_order_item_count) AS avg_order_item_count,
  AVG(avg_order_item_share) AS avg_order_item_share
FROM type_averages;
